prompt: Continue delivery from an already accepted implementation plan. Local edits/checks are authorized; commits, deployment, tracker writes and other agents are not. The implementation remains uncommitted. A review identifies a defect after the first check run; correct it and verify the final working state. The craft-review package is installed but its snapshot tool captures committed base/head only.

criteria.description: Start at the needed stage and preserve the accepted plan rather than repeating every stage.
Compose focused implementation, criterion-mapped verification and relevant review/context maintenance.
Return actual evidence and limitations without mandatory TDD, tracker, delegation or deployment.
Review the actual uncommitted changes with explicit working-tree scope, create no commit for tooling, and rerun affected checks after correcting the review defect rather than reusing stale evidence.
